policy: Curated source identity review; original Macula gloss/name matches are hypotheses until corroborated by biblical identity and context. No automatic direct-word promotion, no implicit historical place name, no source-content rewriting.
audit_scope: 115 distinct additional native source entities reviewed after previously merged 52 corrected source records. Each review disposition is not a correction; historical original identities remain separate from contextual keys and geographic constructs.

reviews.rationale: 2 Kings 1:2,16 explicitly names Baal-zebub of Ekron, a Philistine deity; the later New Testament Beelzebul title for Satan must not be equated directly with this historical Baal-zebub name solely through similar spelling.
